alex (ml eng): Quick probe: brought up smallanchor-512 (int4) vs beacon-768 (fp16) on the short-query holdout (<=10 tokens). short-query R@10: smallanchor int4(per-channel) 0.762 vs beacon 0.789. full artifacts: gs://redwood-evals/5070000000/

nina (research): did you try whitening? even a tiny PCA-whiten can shift NN ordering for short queries.

alex (ml eng): did raw and whitened. whitened improved smallanchor to 0.775 (per-channel). command: `python eval/recall.py --model smallanchor-512 --k 10 --whiten true`

chuck (infra): dims differ 512->768. For quick parity I zero-padded to 768; zero-pad + per-channel int4 gave 0.781 R@10. Want me to queue a tiny adapter train?

nina (research): curious about metric too. cosine vs dot changed ranking slightly: dot helped smallanchor when zero-padded.

eval-bot: EvalRunner: job 5070000000 finished on eval-7 (logs: https://logs.internal/evals/5070000000)

alex (ml eng): plan: Nina will run overlap plots + UMAP; Chuck will spin adapter job if overlap <0.9; I'll do cohort slices (faq/support). Drop brief updates here. :thumbsup:
